packages.summary: A seven-night road journey from Casablanca through Rabat, Meknes, Fez, Marrakech and the coast at Essaouira, with dinners included.
packages.overview: Majestic Morocco takes you from the Hassan II Mosque in Casablanca to the royal city of Rabat, then inland to Meknes, the Roman ruins of Volubilis and the medieval medina of Fez. You cross the cedar forests of the Middle Atlas to Marrakech, spend a full day in its historic sites and souks, and then follow the Atlantic coast through Essaouira, Safi and El Jadida before a final night in Casablanca. Dinner is included at your hotel each evening.

group_trips.title: Morocco Imperial Cities, Blue City and Sahara Group Trip
group_trips.summary: A nine-day small-group journey from Casablanca through Rabat, Chefchaouen and Fez to a night in the Sahara at Merzouga, then Ait Benhaddou and Marrakech.
group_trips.overview:
This fixed-departure trip follows Morocco's classic route, from the Atlantic coast to the edge of the Sahara. You begin in Casablanca and Rabat, then head north to the blue-washed lanes of Chefchaouen and on to Fez, where two nights give you time to explore the medieval medina properly.

From Fez you cross the Middle Atlas to Merzouga for a sunset camel ride on the Erg Chebbi dunes and a night in a desert camp. The return takes in the Todra Gorge, the kasbah of Ait Benhaddou and the High Atlas before two nights in Marrakech. A trip captain travels with the group throughout, and Indian meal options are available on request.
highlights: Hassan II Mosque in Casablanca and the Hassan Tower in Rabat
Chefchaouen, the blue-painted Blue City of the Rif mountains
Two nights in Fez with a guided tour of its medieval medina
Camel ride at sunset on the Erg Chebbi dunes at Merzouga
Night in a Berber-style desert camp under the Saharan sky
Ait Benhaddou kasbah and the High Atlas crossing to Marrakech
Full day in Marrakech with Koutoubia Mosque, Bahia Palace and Djemaa el-Fna
Small group with a trip captain and Indian meal options on request

itinerary.title: Arrival in Casablanca | Hassan II Mosque
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Casablanca Mohammed V Airport and meet your trip captain.
Transfer to your hotel and check in.
In the afternoon, visit the Hassan II Mosque and drive along the Corniche.
Meet your fellow travellers at a welcome dinner.
Overnight stay in Casablanca.

itinerary.title: Rabat | Chefchaouen
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, drive to Rabat, the capital of Morocco.
Visit the Hassan Tower, the Mohammed V Mausoleum and the Kasbah of the Udayas.
After lunch, continue by road towards the Rif mountains to reach Chefchaouen in the evening.
Dinner at the hotel.
Overnight stay in Chefchaouen.

itinerary.title: Chefchaouen Blue City | Drive to Fez
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, walk through the blue-painted lanes of the Chefchaouen medina with your trip captain.
See Plaza Uta el-Hammam and the Kasbah, and enjoy free time for photographs and shopping.
Drive to Fez after lunch.
Dinner at the hotel.
Overnight stay in Fez.

itinerary.title: Fez Medina Full-Day Tour
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, set out with a local guide to explore the medieval medina of Fez.
Visit Bab Boujloud, the Karaouine Mosque exterior, Medersa Bouanania and Place Nejjarine.
See the leather tanneries from a viewing terrace, then enjoy free time in the souks.
Dinner at the hotel.
Overnight stay in Fez.

itinerary.title: Fez to Merzouga | Sahara Camel Ride
itinerary.description:
After an early breakfast, begin the long scenic drive south through the cedar forests of Ifrane and the Middle Atlas.
Stop for lunch along the way before descending into the Ziz valley.
On arrival in Merzouga, ride camels across the Erg Chebbi dunes at sunset.
Dinner and music at the desert camp.
Overnight stay in a desert camp in Merzouga.

itinerary.title: Merzouga to Ouarzazate | Todra Gorge
itinerary.description:
Wake early for sunrise over the dunes, then have breakfast at the camp.
Drive west through the oasis towns of the Tafilalet and Tinghir.
Stop at the Todra Gorge for a short walk beneath its rock walls.
Continue to Ouarzazate in the evening.
Overnight stay in Ouarzazate.

itinerary.title: Ait Benhaddou | High Atlas to Marrakech
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, visit the fortified kasbah village of Ait Benhaddou, a UNESCO World Heritage site.
Drive over the Tizi n'Tichka pass in the High Atlas with photo stops.
Arrive in Marrakech in the late afternoon and check in.
Free evening to try the food stalls of Djemaa el-Fna, with dinner as arranged.
Overnight stay in Marrakech.

itinerary.title: Marrakech City Tour
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, begin a guided tour of Marrakech with the Koutoubia Mosque and Bahia Palace.
Visit the Majorelle Garden and walk through the souks.
Spend the late afternoon at leisure before a farewell dinner with the group.
Overnight stay in Marrakech.

itinerary.title: Departure from Marrakech
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out of the hotel.
Transfer to Marrakech Menara Airport for your flight home.
Depart Morocco with memories of the medinas and the dunes.

honeymoon_trips.title: Morocco Honeymoon: Riad Nights, Desert Stars and Essaouira
honeymoon_trips.summary: A private six-night honeymoon with three nights in a Marrakech riad, a night under the stars in a desert camp in the Agafay foothills of the Atlas, and two unhurried nights by the Atlantic in Essaouira.
honeymoon_trips.overview:
This is Morocco at a gentle pace, made for two. You begin in Marrakech with three nights in a traditional riad, a courtyard house of fountains and lantern light. There is a private guide for the Majorelle Garden, the palaces and the souks, but also long, empty hours for mint tea on the roof terrace and a couples spa session with a traditional hammam.

On the fourth day you leave the city for the Agafay Desert, a landscape of stony hills and open sky in the foothills of the Atlas, about an hour from Marrakech. A short camel ride at sunset, a candle-lit dinner and a night in a desert camp, with no city lights, give you the stars to yourselves.

The journey ends by the Atlantic in Essaouira, a breezy, whitewashed fortress town of ramparts, fishing boats and quiet lanes, where you have a full free day before returning to Marrakech for your flight home. All sightseeing and transfers are private, and our team can arrange a welcome for newly-weds at your stay, subject to availability.
highlights: Three nights in a Marrakech riad, with a private guided tour of the city
Majorelle Garden, Bahia Palace and the souks without the rush of a group
Couples spa session with a traditional Moroccan hammam
Candlelight dinner on a riad roof terrace or courtyard
Sunset camel ride and a night under the stars in the Agafay Desert
Two nights in Essaouira, with its ramparts, harbour and Atlantic breeze
Private car and driver for every transfer

itinerary.title: Arrival in Marrakech | Riad Welcome
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Marrakech Menara Airport, where your private driver meets you.
Transfer to your riad in the medina, where a welcome for the newly-weds awaits, subject to availability.
Settle in with mint tea in the courtyard.
The evening is free; stroll to Djemaa el-Fna at your own pace if you wish.
Overnight stay in Marrakech.

itinerary.title: Marrakech | Gardens, Palaces and Souks
itinerary.description:
After a late breakfast, meet your private guide for a relaxed tour of Marrakech.
Visit the Majorelle Garden and Bahia Palace, and see the Koutoubia Mosque from outside.
Walk through the souks and the old medina lanes with time to browse.
The afternoon is free to rest or return to your favourite corner.
Overnight stay in Marrakech.

itinerary.title: Spa and Candlelight Dinner
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a slow morning at the riad.
In the afternoon, a couples spa session with a traditional hammam is arranged, subject to availability.
The rest of the day is yours to wander the medina or relax on the roof terrace.
In the evening, enjoy a candlelight dinner arranged for the two of you.
Overnight stay in Marrakech.

itinerary.title: Agafay Desert | Night Under the Stars
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out and drive with your private driver to the Agafay Desert, about an hour from Marrakech.
Check in at your desert camp and relax with mint tea.
Take a short camel ride across the stony hills at sunset.
Dinner is served at the camp under the open sky, followed by time to stargaze.
Overnight stay in the Agafay Desert camp.

itinerary.title: Drive to Essaouira | Sunset on the Ramparts
itinerary.description:
Have breakfast at the camp and watch the morning light on the hills.
Drive to Essaouira on the Atlantic coast, a journey of roughly three to four hours with stops.
Check in to your hotel and rest after the drive.
In the evening, walk along the ramparts and the Skala to watch the sun go down over the ocean.
Overnight stay in Essaouira.

itinerary.title: Essaouira at Leisure
itinerary.description:
A free day with no fixed plans, after a late breakfast.
Walk through the whitewashed medina, visit the fishing harbour and stroll along the beach.
Our team can suggest cafes, craft shops and quiet corners, with any extras arranged on request.
Enjoy your last evening by the sea.
Overnight stay in Essaouira.

itinerary.title: Return to Marrakech | Departure
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out of the hotel.
Drive back to Marrakech, which takes roughly three hours.
Transfer to Marrakech Menara Airport for your flight home.
Depart Morocco with memories of the riad, the desert and the sea.
